advisories.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect command injection
advisories.summary: A flaw in specific PAN-OS releases with GlobalProtect enabled can allow unauthenticated command execution. Palo Alto Networks reported exploitation in the wild.
advisories.action: Confirm affected versions and GlobalProtect configuration, apply a vendor-fixed release, and review the vendor's incident guidance.

advisories.title: Log4Shell in Apache Log4j
advisories.summary: Unsafe JNDI lookup behavior in vulnerable Log4j 2 releases allowed remote code execution through attacker-controlled logged data.
advisories.action: Inventory applications and bundled libraries, upgrade to a currently supported fixed Log4j release, and check exposure using Apache's security guidance.

advisories.title: XZ Utils supply-chain backdoor
advisories.summary: Malicious code was introduced into selected XZ Utils release artifacts, creating a serious supply-chain exposure for affected Linux builds.
advisories.action: Use your distribution's advisory to identify affected packages, replace them with trusted builds, and investigate exposed systems.
